meta.title: International Relations knowledge network, c. 1977-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in general International Relations: cooperation and institutions, law and compliance, human rights, norms, legitimacy, regime complexity, order and hierarchy, public opinion and climate. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json; works shared with the IPE and security maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref plus anchoring classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works shared with the IPE and security maps keep their earlier verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. All new anchors were found in Crossref (books often via reviews, chapters or reprint DOIs). One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
